title: One strand short
logline: The string lights at Gully's ending a yard short of the eave's corner, the last bracket empty, the boy, ten, looking up at the gap. The page keeps the gap; it'll be filled by 2026 when he's on the ladder.

panels.composition: Colored string lights along a shingle shack's eave ending a yard short of the corner with an empty bracket, a boy of ten looking up at the gap from the dock.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, colored string lights along a shingle shack's eave ending short of the corner with an empty bracket and a boy of ten on the dock looking up at the gap, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
